:::{#exr-mse-expand}
#### Expanding the mean squared error

Write the [mean squared error](#def-mse) $\mselr{\hth}$
in terms of $\E{\hth^2}$, $\E{\hth}$, and the estimand $\th$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-mse-expand}

$$
\begin{aligned}
\mselr{\hth}
&\eqdef \E{\sqf{\erf{\hth}}}
&& \text{(definition of MSE)}\\
&= \E{(\hth - \th)^2}
&& \text{(definition of estimation error)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2 - 2\hth\th + \th^2}
&& \text{(expand the binomial square)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2} - \E{2\hth\th} + \E{\th^2}
&& \text{(linearity of expectation)}\\
&= \E{\hth^2} - 2\E{\hth}\th + \th^2
&& \text{($\th$ is a constant)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
